description: The off hand: a golden apple eaten from it with an empty main hand, past a sword and past a bow without arrows, kept on through a hotbar change; a shield blocking from it while walking; swapping hands while blocking and while eating.

world.note: Fabric client gametest defaults: flat world, no structures, time and weather frozen, no mob spawning

harness: Fabric client gametest: one client tick per frame, one server tick per client tick
